# LongCat attribution

The selected LoRA adapters and fact codecs in this repository were trained with
[LongCat-Flash-Lite](https://huggingface.co/meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Lite),
using the [MLX community 4-bit conversion](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/LongCat-Flash-Lite-4bit)
at revision `0435b3bca4418830335d784317fe7f67f8383253`.
The upstream weights are not redistributed here. The original upstream MIT
license is retained alongside this notice. The selected adapters and new codec
are published under this repository's MIT license.

Reference: Hong Liu et al., *Scaling Embeddings Outperforms Scaling Experts in
Language Models*, 2026, [arXiv:2601.21204](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21204).
